title: Find the right configuration owner
when: A value could belong to a Pack, project, environment, machine or universe
need: Separate install-time Pack specialization, live project capability settings, environment settings, machine connections and universe settings. Use the owning registered read/help, not raw config inspection.
surface: Projects and Capabilities guides explain parts; CLI and config covers the machine/universe boundary.
gap: No complete scenario-to-owner path was traced for arbitrary feature settings. Do not claim a generic settings UI or validator exists for every capability.
